ars_scalaes.glyph_desc.glyph_resize: Resizes the target entity for a short time or resets to original size if not augmented. Use Amplify to grow and Dampen to shrink.
ars_technica.armor_set.artificer.desc: Reduces damage from Create machinery, increases speed of nearby schematic cannons
ars_technica.armor_set.machinaguard.desc: Reduces damage from Create machinery, increases speed of nearby schematic cannons
ars_technica.armor_set.technomancer.desc: Reduces damage from Create machinery, increases speed of nearby schematic cannons
ars_technica.category.ars_technica.desc: The intersection of Create machinery and Ars Nouveau spellcraft.
ars_technica.create_goggles_info: Augments your HUD with miscellaneous information about placed Create components
ars_technica.effect_augment_desc.glyph_p: With Extract: use for heated Compact recipes
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_apply: Uses the item in your offhand to perform Manual Item Application or Deploy to blocks or items. Non-player casters use adjacent inventories instead of off-hand
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_carve: Cuts identical item entities, crafting them into stairs. Works on stone and wood only. §a[Create Recipe: Cutting]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_fuse: Fuses item entities by slamming them together at breakneck speed. Picks up fluids from nearby fluid containers. Can be combined with Smelt or Superheat (if enabled).
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_insert: Inserts item entities into nearby containers in a medium radius where this spell is activated
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_obliterate: Obliterates foes by sheer force with an arcane hammer. Can be augmented with Sensitive to process item entities. §a[Create Recipe: Crushing Wheels]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_pack: Condenses identical item entities, crafting them into 2x2 recipes. §a[Create Recipe: Pack]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_polish: Refines item entities into their polished variants. §a[Create Recipe: Polish]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_press: Flattens item entities into their pressed variants.
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_superheat: When used in combination with Fuse, super-heats ingredients
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_telefeast: Consumes the first edible/potion, or some amount of liquid, found in the container/tank this was cast on.
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_whirl: Creates a whirlwind in an area, causing item entities to be centrifuged. Combine with water/flare/smelt/hex to process items.
ars_technica.page.armor_set.technomancer: Attuned to Create machinery and the School of Manipulation, each piece of this armor will amplify manipulation glyphs, reduce damage from Create machinery like crushers and saws, and the helmet augments your HUD with Create component info. When all the pieces are equipped, nearby Schematic Cannons operate faster
ars_technica.page.create_processing.depo: These process item entities placed in the world. Press, Polish, Obliterate and Whirl additionally function on Create depots.
ars_technica.page.create_processing.intr: The following glyphs can be used as substitutes for Create processes:
ars_technica.page1.arcane_wrench: The Arcane Wrench is Create's Wrench augmented with Ars Nouveau magic. Obtain it by enchanting a Create Wrench in the Enchanting Apparatus.
ars_technica.page1.create_processing:
The following glyphs can be used as substitutes for Create processes:

These process item entities placed in the world. Press, Polish, Obliterate and Whirl additionally function on Create depots.
ars_technica.page1.processing: Ars Technica adds glyphs that perform Create-style processing: Pressing, Polishing, Mixing, Crushing, and more. Hover the glyphs below for Create recipe details.
ars_technica.page1.transmutation: Transmutation augments spells with Luck and improved processing. Focus: wear in Curios focus slot—hover for bonuses. Turret: automated caster with Focus applied, costs more source per cast.
ars_technica.page2.arcane_wrench:
Additional capabilities:

- Rune blocks: Right-click to configure cooldown
- Relays: Right-click to convert a Relay into a Precise Relay to configure its cooldown
- Pedestals, Turrets, Containment Jars: Sneak + right-click to pick up.
ars_technica.page2.processing:
Depot support: Only Press, Polish, Obliterate, and Whirl work when cast on a Create Depot. Cast on the depot to automate processing from its inventory.

Carve, Pack, and Fuse work on item entities in the world only—they do not support depot automation.
ars_technica.patchouli.technomancer.perk:
All three Technomancer variants (Technomancer, Artificer, Machinaguard) share these perks when wearing a full set:

$(li)$(bold)Damage reduction$() - Reduced damage from Create machinery (e.g. crushers, saws)
$(li)$(bold)Schematicannon boost$() - Nearby Schematic Cannons operate faster
$(li)$(bold)Manipulation school$() - Bonus manipulation spell power
$(li)$(bold)Goggles$() - The helmet augments your HUD with Create component info
ars_technica.perk_desc.thread_pressure: Grants the wielder ultra-high-pressure air. Air refills over time - higher levels means more capacity and faster fill rate.
ars_technica.ponder.source_motor.text_1: This block can be used to convert Source into rotational force.
ars_technica.ponder.source_motor.text_2: It must be supplied with a nearby Source Jar.
ars_technica.ponder.source_motor.text_3: Adjust the RPM on the sides of the motor, right-click elsewhere to adjust the SU-to-RPM ratio
ars_technica.ponder.source_motor.text_4: Adjusting the SU-to-RPM ratio will conversely adjust the amount of source required
ars_technica.tooltip.transmutation_focus: Augments spells with Luck and improves various glyphs
2x chance-based item outputs from Crush, Obliterate and Whirl
+1 Luck Augment per Glyph in your spell
2x items processed by Press and Polish
2x speed for Press, Polish and Whirl
ars_technica.tooltip.transmutation_turre: Casts spells infused with the Focus of Transmutation. Costs x%s more source.
ars_trinkets.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_not: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets the caster.
ars_trinkets.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_sel: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets the caster.
ars_zero.alert.multiphase_turret.empty_s: Select a device slot containing at least one phase spell.
ars_zero.alert.multiphase_turret.multi_p: Multiphase turrets require a multi-phase spell device.
ars_zero.alert.multiphase_turret.no_spel: Could not read spell data from that device.
ars_zero.augment_desc.amplify_three_gene: Increases the power of the effect (stronger than Amplify II).
ars_zero.augment_desc.amplify_two_generi: Increases the power of the effect (stronger than Amplify).
ars_zero.augment_desc.aoe_three_generic: Increases the area of effect (stronger than AOE II).
ars_zero.augment_desc.aoe_two_generic: Increases the area of effect (stronger than AOE).
ars_zero.augment_desc.effect_geometrize_: Processes blocks from bottom to top instead of top to bottom.
ars_zero.effect_augment_desc.effect_conv: Sacred Conjure Water: Fills a large area with water from bottom to top. Water Power affects placement speed. AOE determines radius. Drains mana per block placed.

Megasplosion: Creates an enormous explosion that charges over time. Fire Power affects charge rate, explosion radius and ignition (at 8+ turns into Extinguishing Soulfire Explosion). AOE determines radius. Amplify increases damage (to blocks/entities). Dampen decreases damage and radius.
ars_zero.effect_augment_desc.effect_geom: Break Structure: Breaks blocks in a geometric pattern. Drains mana per block broken.
Place Terrain: Creates a structure with blocks defined by regular Conjure Terrain augments/effects. Drains mana per block placed.
ars_zero.examples.ekusupuroshon.quote: "Darkness blacker than black, and darker than dark"

ars_zero.page.lifespan_based_effects.int: Some glyphs in Ars Zero spawn entities that exist only for their lifespan. These entities change state when their duration runs out - for example disappearing, exploding, starting a process. To keep them in their initial state you must use either the Anchor glyph or the Sustain glyph. The next page shows all lifespan-based effects.
ars_zero.page1.overview: Ars Zero extends Ars Nouveau with multiphase spellcasting, allowing devices such as Spell Staves and Spellcasting Circlets to chain multiple spells in sequence.
ars_zero.page1.phase_targeting:
Because spells work completely in isolation, you must use the special form "Temporal Context" in order to do something with the previous phase's target.

For example, you can conjure a voxel in "begin", and have Temporal Context in your "tick" with Anchor, then Temporal Context with Push in your "end" phase.

This will allow you to create, aim and fire a projectile in the direction you're aiming.
ars_zero.page1.spell_phases:
A phase is a description of a lifecycle of an incantation with multiple spells. Where spells hold multiple glyphs, devices that are multi-phased hold multiple spells, though these are always fired in sequences; begin, tick and end.

Once a device - such as a Spell Staff - begins being used, it fires the begin phase, once. Every subsequent tick, the "tick" phase executes the spell it holds. Upon stopping, finally the end phase's spell is performed.

Additionally, it is possible to configure the delay the tick phase has by scrolling the icon on the tick row.

create.ponder.analog_lever.text_1: 律呂閘刀者，乃精巧而準確之赤石力源也
create.ponder.analog_lever.text_2: 右擊之，可增其信號之力
create.ponder.analog_lever.text_3: 潛行而右擊，則復減其力
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_1: 可用行程書為駕車士指定其的
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_2: 凡有火輪車在，則較赭儀必有所應
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_3: 須知，車驛唯可以所示之方向駛入
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_4: 車驛亦可用以自行分派新之行程書
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_5: 置於車驛之行期，將自錄於到站之車上
create.ponder.auto_schedule.text_6: 與手動編排不同，駕車士此時不隨身攜帶行程書
create.ponder.basin.text_1: 煉釜可容納萬物與流體，以供煉製
create.ponder.basin.text_2: 煉製既畢，釜中之物將自下側而出
create.ponder.basin.text_3: 若旁有可用之機件，則釜上將顯現流口之形
create.ponder.basin.text_5: 凡所出之物，將為下方藏器所納
create.ponder.basin.text_6: 煉釜若無流口，則其中所造之物，將留存其內
create.ponder.basin.text_7: 若產物須復為原料，則此法甚善
create.ponder.basin.text_8: 欲取之物，則須自釜中引出
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_1: 靜止之時，軸承將置其結構於最近之格線夾角
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_2: 可設使其永不復歸方塊，或僅在始發之角附近復歸
create.ponder.belt_casing.text_1: 滾帶可以黃銅機匣及安山機匣飾之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_1: 手持機帶，右擊二機軸，即可使之相連
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_2: 若有誤選，可潛行右擊以棄之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_3: 機帶之上，可隨處增設機軸
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_4: 凡以機帶相連之機軸，其轉速、轉向皆同
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_5: 已增之機軸，可以扳手移之
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_6: 為觀瞻計，機帶可染雜色
create.ponder.belt_directions.text_5: 四則，亦可以之水平連接垂直之機軸
create.ponder.belt_directions.text_6: 此皆可用之朝向也。機帶之長，可在二至二十步之間
create.ponder.belt_transport.text_1: 行進之機帶，可轉運諸物與生靈
create.ponder.belt_transport.text_2: 以空手右擊，可自機帶上取物
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_1: 焱靈爐能供熾熱，以助釜中煉物
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_3: 則其爐火可達更熾熱之境
create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_4: 投餵之事，可假施用機或機關臂之力，使其自行
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_1: 安山漏斗惟可取一物耳。
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_2: 黃銅漏斗，一次可取物盈一疊之數
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_3: 以度盤可精定其所取之數
create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_4: 置物於甄選槽，則漏斗僅轉運相合之物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_1: 黃銅甬道可用以遮蔽機帶
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_2: 黃銅甬道可用以遮蔽機帶
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_3: 黃銅甬道每處開口，皆有甄選槽
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_4: 入口之甄選，僅阻不合之物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_5: 出口之甄選，可用以依類分物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_6: 並行機帶上之黃銅甬道，將自成一組
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_7: 凡所入之物，將分派至所有相連之出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_8: 為此，亦可徑直置物入甬道之中
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_1: 黃銅甬道之分派法式，可以設定
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_10: 「同步入口」乃黃銅甬道之獨有設定
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_11: 唯組中每處甬道皆有物待發，諸物方可通行
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_12: 此法可保所有相關機帶，皆以同速供物
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_2: 「均分」者，試將一疊之物，均分於諸可用之出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_3: 若有出口不能再納物，則越之
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_4: 「強制均分」則永不越過，必待其有容乃發
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_5: 「輪巡」者，保其疊之完整，周行於諸出口
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_6: 若有出口不能再納物，則越之
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_8: 「擇近」者，以距物之入口最近之出口為先
create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_9: 「隨機」者，將整疊之物，隨意分派至一出口
create.ponder.cart_assembler.header: 以礦車合裝器移動結構
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_1: 已得功力之礦車合裝器，可將所附結構，駕於過路之礦車上
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_2: 若無赤石信號，則將過路之礦車機關，解體復歸方塊
create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_3: 以扳手擊礦車，可攜其機關至他處。
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_1: 凡二礦車合裝器共一結構…
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_2: 此二者，任一受力，即可造成行臺機關
create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_3: 則諸礦車之行，將如聯鉤所繫者
create.ponder.cart_assembler_modes.text_: 礦車機關將隨其礦車之行向而轉動
此箭頭所示，乃結構之正面
若合裝器已鎖其轉動，則機關之朝向永不改變
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: 尋常軌道上之合裝器，不礙過路礦車之行進
若在動力軌或主控軌上，則礦車將滯留原地，直至得力方行
熔爐礦車將自行供力，自所附之藏器中抽取爐薪
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_1: 手持鏈條，右擊二傳送帶，即可使之相連
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_4: 手持扳手右擊，即可沿鏈而行
create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_5: 至路口，面向鏈條，即可隨之而行
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_1: 諸鏈輪可列隊互傳轉動
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_2: 凡如此相連之機軸，其轉向皆同
create.ponder.chain_drive.text_3: 隊列中任意一環，皆可旋轉九十度
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_1: 無功力之鏈輪變速，其行與鏈輪無異
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_2: 若得功力，則其傳至他鏈輪之速將倍增
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_3: 若得力之變速器非在源頭，則其速將折半
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_4: 此二情況，隊列中之鏈輪，其速常為得力變速器之兩倍
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_5: 若用無級信號，其倍率可於一至二之間精調
create.ponder.chute.text_1: 物井可於上下藏器之間，垂直轉運諸物
create.ponder.chute.text_3: 以機工鐵塊，可為物井造匣
create.ponder.chute.text_4: 置物井於另一井之側，則二者斜接
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_1: 橐龠置於物井之上下，可令其中諸物逆流而上
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_2: 以匠人鏡觀之，可明其內物之行向
create.ponder.chute_upward.text_3: 於其堵塞之一端，諸物須自側面存取
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_1: 發條軸承可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_2: 凡得功力，其上結構，將應一日之時辰而旋
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_5: 右擊軸承，以啟或止其結構之動
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_6: 於時針之前，可增設第二結構
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_7: 務使二結構未以天工膠相連
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_8: 則第二結構將如分針一般轉動
create.ponder.clutch.text_1: 陰陽掣可沿直線傳遞轉動
create.ponder.clutch.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則斷其接續
create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_1: 異類齒輪相接，其力可斜傳之
create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_1: 齒輪可以黃銅機匣及安山機匣飾之
create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_2: 凡造匣之後所增之機件，皆不能與機軸相連
create.ponder.contraption_controls.text_: 動件於行進機關之上，其本用乃時刻啟用
可用機關主控，隨時啟閉之
可附於機關之上任意之處
解體之時，可變更其甄選，以指定動件之類
若於合裝之時，為赤石所啟用…
…則所指之動件，自始即為關閉之態
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_1: 無盡儲液罐可供不絕之流體
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_2: 以盛流體之物右擊之，以設定其類
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_3: 流管網路可取之不盡所置之液
create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_4: 凡回流至無盡儲液罐之流體，皆將歸於虛無
create.ponder.creative_motor.header: 以無盡功力機產生旋力
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_1: 無盡功力機者，乃精巧可設之功力之源也
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: 其所生之速率，可於其輸入度盤上設定
create.ponder.creative_motor_mojang.head: 魔贊之秘術
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: 置或放入碾輪之物品皆碾碎
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_4: 君亦可自動化物之出入
create.ponder.deployer.text_1: 施用機若得旋力，即可仿遊者之行
create.ponder.deployer.text_10: 右手擊其正面，以授其物
create.ponder.deployer.text_13: 若設甄選，則唯持相合之物時，方能啟用
create.ponder.deployer.text_2: 其所用，常在身前兩步之遙
create.ponder.deployer_contraption.text_: 凡施用機隨行進之機關而動...
則於所經之處，皆將觸發其功用，所用之物，可取自機關上任意藏器
可用甄選槽以指定所取之物
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_1: 施用機之本用，乃仿右手之擊
create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_2: 以扳手擊之，可改為仿左手之擊
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_1: 施用機若手持合用之物，則能炮製其下之物
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_2: 待用之物，可置於施用機下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_4: 則施用機將自行持物施用
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_1: 凡赤石加力之時，施用機則不行其事
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: 止歇之前，施用機必盡其已發之往復
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: 是故，可藉信脈斷絕之瞬，觸發其一輪往復
create.ponder.depot.text_2: 以右手擊之，可手置或取物
create.ponder.depot.text_3: 其用有如機帶，可供物料整製
create.ponder.display_board.text_1: 揭示榜乃告示牌之可伸縮者也
create.ponder.display_board.text_3: 可以已書之錄事板，為之賦予靜態之文
create.ponder.display_board.text_4: 亦可以示聯，賦予動態之文
create.ponder.display_board.text_5: 可以染料，為榜上各行分染其色
create.ponder.display_board.text_6: 以空手擊之，可復原各行
create.ponder.display_link.text_1: 示聯可用以使動態訊息顯於目前
create.ponder.display_link.text_3: …而後附於所欲讀取之方塊…而後附於所欲讀取之方塊
create.ponder.display_link.text_4: 啟其圖儀，以擇定所發之訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_5: 此後，揭示榜將自示聯處接收訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_7: 凡相合之方塊，皆供獨有之訊息
create.ponder.display_link.text_8: 一示聯可與數種不同之揭示器共用
create.ponder.display_link_redstone.head: 赤石節制
create.ponder.display_link_redstone.text: 凡赤石加力，則示聯止其更新
凡其力斷焉，其計時復原，新訊息亦將即刻發送
源頭所發之信號，不礙示聯
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_1: 雲梯機可於已標之位間，垂直移動結構
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_10: 凡在此列之赤石觸點，皆將轉化
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_11: 予以赤石一脈，可召升降臺至觸點之處
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_12: 其移動之速，悉決於雲梯機所得之旋力
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_13: 身處轎中，可以滾輪點擊主控，以擇樓層
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_14: 右擊已合裝之吊具，可使升降轎復歸為方塊
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_15: 附於升降轎之滑門，將自行啟閉
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_16: 升降轎抵達其層時，升降觸點將發信號
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_17: 此可用於抵達之時，觸發門戶或有他效
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_18: 觸點上之示聯，可示升降轎所在之樓層
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_3: 置一對赤石觸點，使其相對…
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_4: …而後以天工膠黏其一於行進之結構
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_5: 可附機關主控，以使樓層之擇選更為便利
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_7: 右擊吊具，以合裝升降臺
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_8: 靜止之觸點，此時將化為升降觸點
create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_9: 升降觸點代表一層，可以設定
create.ponder.elevator_pulley_multi_rope: …則同層之他吊具亦將與此結構相連
此等無需功力，其效僅為觀瞻而已
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_1: 以空爐右擊焱靈以捕之
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_2: 抑或，可徑直自擎衍籠以捕焱靈。
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_3: 現已得諸般機械之絕佳熱源
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_4: 為觀瞻計，空置之焱靈爐，亦可以火石點燃
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_5: 以淬靈之物，可轉化其火焰
create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_6: 然，若無焱靈，則不適於工業之加熱
create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_2: 覆殼之法，可藏流管，亦可定其態
create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_3: 縱毗鄰之管有變，不能致其改也
create.ponder.factory_gauge_crafting.tex: 工坊量計可為造物臺之法式，自行排布
一如往昔，連接所需之原料
凡察得可用之法式，則圖儀之中，新鍵現焉
若自行排布之法已啟，則諸箱匣可徑直解包於機造臺中
其陣必為三乘三，且諸臺須以扳手相連
長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定其的之數
此機造臺此後可為通用，供諸般持不同法式之量計所用
產物当送返已連之藏器，以成閉環
為防所入包裹散亂，宜用理包機
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_1: 自圖儀增設新接續之時…
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_2: …量計亦可接續赤石鏈與示聯
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_3: 當倉儲之量及於或逾於其的之數，則赤石鏈得其力
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_4: 於接收之式下，鏈接可止量計發送請領
create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_5: 示聯可提供所連量計之情狀概覽
create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.heade: 以工坊量計自行運作法式
create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.text_: 凡量計未置於包裹之上……
指定原料所應發往之地址
可長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定所維持之的數
每當脈絡中之物，少於此數…
…則將發送新原料至所指之址
其後，產物須歸返至任一已連之藏器
綠色之接續，示其的之數已達
量計之板面可擴展，以容納更多法式之步驟
每座量計皆獨立維持其物之倉儲量
然其將轉而監看所有已連藏器之倉儲量
以所欲監看之物，右擊之
此後將示脈絡中之總量
量計可發送他物以供措置，從而補充倉儲
先以新工坊量計之形式，增設所需之原料
可自其的之圖儀，建立新接續
為觀瞻計，可以機匙改變輸入度盤之路徑
於圖儀中，審閱諸般輸入，並指定每批產物之數量
create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.he: 以工坊量計補充倉儲法
create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.te: 置放之先，右擊倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
…則轉運脈絡將依所指之址，發送更多
工坊量計若置於封包機上，可監看其內藏器之物
以所欲監看之物，右擊之
此後將示藏器中之現有數量
量計可自轉運脈絡補充此藏器
復擊之，以啟其設定圖儀
設定所請領之物應使用之地址
此時可長按右鍵於量計之上，以設定所維持之的數
每當箱中之物，少於此數…
create.ponder.fan_direction.text_2: 風之流，其強弱與方向，悉決於輸入之旋力
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_1: 風之流若經熔岩，則化為熱風
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_2: 凡在此域中之物，皆將被熔煉
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_3: 食物擲於此，將焚為灰燼
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: 然，當以火設局，以行燻烤之法
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_5: 風之流若經水，則成淘洗之局
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_6: 藉此可成若干新奇之措置
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: 橐龠之速率，不礙措置之速，僅及其界而已
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: 風機之化，亦可及於貨墩、機帶之物
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_2: 以矯具右擊，可致其琉璃狀，利觀其內
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_3: 璃面流管，僅可直輸，不可通其鄰
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_4: 流管以機關唧筒輸液也
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: 流體連通二者，則其末端將漸次轉移其內物
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: 是故，管道方塊之內，實無流體存焉
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_interaction.tex: 管道脈絡之末端，可與諸般方塊相通
凡可容流體之方塊，皆可注之汲之
敞口之前，凡有源流，皆可拾取
管道亦可徑直自若干他類方塊中抽取流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_1: 諸儲液罐可合併，以增其總容積
create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_4: 以矯具右擊，可開合儲液罐之璃窗，利觀其內
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_1: 儲液罐可用以納巨量流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_2: 管道脈絡可自任意一面，推拉流體
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_3: 其中所容之流體，可以較赭儀度量之
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_4: 然，凡俗之世中，流體不可手動存取
create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_5: 可用煉釜、物渠、注機，以出入盛流體之器
create.ponder.funnel_compat.text_1: 漏斗亦可與若干他類機件相合而用
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_1: 尋常置之，則自藏器取物
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_2: 潛行置之，則存物入藏器
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_3: 置定之後，可以扳手翻轉之
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_4: 此法於諸般朝向，大抵皆同
create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_5: 置於機帶之上，則其存取隨帶之行向而定
create.ponder.funnel_intro.text_1: 漏斗者，於諸藏器之間轉運貨殖之利器也
create.ponder.funnel_redstone.text_1: 赤石加力，則漏斗不行其事
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_1: 漏斗絕不能於閉合之藏器間徑直轉運
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_2: 若為此類用途，則以物井或巧井為佳
create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_3: 水平轉運亦然。此時當以機帶相助
create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_1: 天車行臺可駕於天車軸之上，沿軸而行
create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_2: 天車機關可移其所附之方塊
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_1: 天車軸之接於行臺，無需用天工膠
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_2: 行進中之天車軸，其上行臺亦然
create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_3: 是故，天車可層疊而設，以應多軸之行
create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_2: 行臺之行向，依其軸之朝向而定
create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_4: 凡其所傳之旋力，其法亦同
create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_1: 為赤石所驅之天車軸，將止其行臺之移動
create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_2: 其旋力將轉而傳至行臺之輸出機軸
create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_1: 天車軸乃天車之基石。所附之行臺將沿軸而行
create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_2: 天車機關可移動其所附之方塊
create.ponder.gearbox.text_1: 跨軸傳遞旋力，動輒顯其臃腫
create.ponder.gearbox.text_2: 齒輪匣則為此法之精巧者也
create.ponder.gearbox.text_3: 轉角之機軸，其轉向相反如鏡
create.ponder.gearbox.text_4: 凡徑直相連，其轉向將逆
create.ponder.gearshift.text_1: 變向機匣可沿直線以遞旋力
create.ponder.gearshift.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則逆其傳動之向
create.ponder.hand_crank.text_1: 遊者可以轆轤柄，手動施加旋力
create.ponder.hand_crank.text_3: 潛行長按右擊以右旋之
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_1: 以水喉吊索行流體摧取或充溢之事于開闊之地，其便利哉
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_2: 藉由功力之輸入，可節制水喉之高低
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_3: 若功力逆轉，則吊索卷收
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_4: 其另一側，則可接續管道
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_5: 所連之管道，既可供流體於水喉...
create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_7: 水喉注汲之速，悉決於管道通達之量
create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.text_: 若將水喉吊索垂入瀚海……
則其取與，皆無損於其源。
管道可自此等吊索，無盡取與。
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_1: 吊索盡收之時，則不能行其事
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_3: 其澤之表，終將略低於水喉之末
create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_5: 所注之澤，其高不過水喉之末上一層
create.ponder.item_drain.header: 以物渠汲取諸物之流體
create.ponder.item_drain.text_1: 物渠可自諸物中汲取流體
create.ponder.item_drain.text_2: 右擊之，可將手中之物所盛流體，傾入其中
create.ponder.item_drain.text_5: 管道脈絡，此時可自物渠內儲中抽取流體
create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_1: 諸秘庫可合併，以增其總容積
create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_2: 然，其中之物不可手動存取
create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_3: 凡轉運物品之機件，既可存物於內…
create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_2: 此將所傳之速率，轉至他軸
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_1: 大水車者，隨流水之勢而轉，力之源也
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_2: 使流水覆他方，弗能曾其力
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_4: ……然其功力承載，則遠高於前者
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_5: 手執木材，擊之，得更其貌
潛行且以空手右擊，則黏漿可去
機骨之黏面，能附其前直列之方物
以扳手測之，可精定其附物之距
若行合控之法，則諸相連之機骨，其距可一併而調
若欲附物於他面，則必用天工膠
循此諸法，萬物不拘其形，皆可聯為一體，成大機關而行
create.ponder.linear_chassis_group.text_: 直機骨，可與其旁同類者相連
機關動其一，則眾皆隨行
然機骨之類、之向苟異，則不相連也
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_1: 機關臂於設置之前，須先指定其出入之口
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_2: 手持機臂，右擊諸藏器，即可指定為的
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_3: 復擊之，可更易其出入（藍為入，黃為出）
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_5: 一旦置定，機關臂將尋先前所選之的而動
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_6: 在其界內，出入之口，數量不拘
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_7: 然，非所有藏器皆可直接取與
create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_8: 漏斗與貨墩，可為橋樑以渡其隙
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.t: 或需以甄選之法，約束機關臂之的
機關臂本身，無甄選之能
然，若以黃銅漏斗為的，則其甄選之法，可為機關臂所知
機關臂亦有靈智，凡不能分派之物，概不拾取
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.text_: 機關臂若需於數個可用之出口中擇一
可於度盤之上，為其設法
「輪巡」者，周行於諸可用之出口也
若有出口不能再納物，則越之
「強制輪巡」則永不越過，必待其有容乃發
「首選其的」者，以最早編設之出口為先
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: 凡赤石加力之時，機關臂則不行其事
止歇之前，必盡其已發之往復
是故，可藉信脈斷絕之瞬，觸發其一輪往復
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.header: 以機關軸承移動結構之法
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_1: 機關軸承可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: 凡受旋力，則將其合裝為旋轉機關
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_1: 列成方陣之機造臺，可用以自行運作諸般造物法式
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_2: 以扳手，可為諸臺安排其路徑
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_3: 欲使其可用，則諸路徑須歸於一處，以為出口，方向不拘
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_4: 凡所造之物，將置於出口處之藏器內
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_5: 機造臺需得以旋力，方能運作
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_6: 右擊其正面，可手動入物
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_7: 一旦路徑中每格皆有物，則造物之程將啟
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_8: 若法式未滿佔臺陣，可以赤石信脈一瞬，強使其啟動
create.ponder.mechanical_crafter_connect: 諸物可自行置入機造臺
以機匙擊其背，可合諸臺之入口為一
此後，凡相連之機造臺，皆可由同一入口納物
部分法式，或需額外之機造臺，以填路徑之隙
以槽蓋蔽之，可使機造臺於陣列中，視為空格
以扳手於其背所造之共用入口，亦可跨越被蔽之臺
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_1: 鑽機若得旋力，則可破碎其正前方之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_2: 其開採之速，悉決於旋力之大小
create.ponder.mechanical_drill_contrapti: 凡鑽機隨行進之機關而動...
...則機關所遇之方塊，皆將為其所碎
create.ponder.mechanical_harvester.text_: 凡機關鐮隨行進之機關而動…
…則將收割沿途所有已熟之作物，並使其復歸原狀
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_1: 合用合料機與煉釜，部分造物之法可自行運作
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_2: 可用之法式，含諸般無序造物之法，並若干額外之法
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_3: 此類法式之中，部分或需焱靈爐之熾熱相助
create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_4: 若兩法互擾，可用甄選槽以解之
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.header: 以機關鞴鞴移動結構之法
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_1: 機關鞴鞴可推動其前之塊方
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_2: 其行進之速與向，悉決於旋力功力之輸入
create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_3: 黏性機關鞴鞴，可將其所附之方塊拖回
create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.te: 凡鞴鞴止歇，其所動之結構，將復歸為方塊
可設使其永不復歸，或僅於始發之位復歸
create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_1: 凡機關犁隨行進之機關而動…
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_2: 待煉之物，可擲於機榨之下，或置於其下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_4: 則機榨將自行夾持鍛壓
create.ponder.mechanical_press_compactin: 釜中所容之物，若以機榨壓之，將使其聚合
聚合之法，可用於諸般二乘二、三乘三之造物法式，亦含若干額外之法
此類法式之中，部分或需焱靈爐之熾熱相助
若兩法互擾，可用甄選槽以解之
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: 機關唧筒主掌其所連管道脈絡之流動
其上箭頭，示流動之向也
其後之脈絡，於斯時汲取流體…
…而前方之脈絡，則將其向外輸送
唧筒之方向，不受輸入旋力之轉向所動
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.head: 機關唧筒之通量
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: 機關唧筒，不論其速，其效可及十六步內之相連管道
旋力之大小，可變更流傳之速…
於共用之管道脈絡中，諸唧筒之通量可合併
create.ponder.mechanical_roller_fill.tex: 解體之時，轢機可設為他法式
「填充」之法式，可用以彌合鋪路與地貌之隙
於「直填」之式，將置簡柱直達地表
於「斜填」之式，愈向下鋪設，其層愈廣
與「清障鋪路」不同，此二法式皆不毀壞已有之方塊
create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.tex: 轢機可助清理軌道或路徑周圍之地貌
其本用之下，若無定式，則僅破除方塊而已
解體之時，可指定合用之鋪路物料
物料可由附於結構之箱匣供給
其破碎方塊之餘，亦將替換其下之一層
須知，凡為轢機所毀之方塊，或不掉落
轢機之於火輪車，其用尤顯，然亦可用於諸般行進之機關
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.tex: 解木機若得旋力，則可伐其正前方之樹木
欲盡伐全樹，則須斷其與地相連之最後根基
create.ponder.mechanical_saw_contraption: 凡解木機隨行進之機關而動...
...則機關所遇之樹木，皆將為其所伐
朝天之解木機，可剖解諸般物事
已剖解之物，其行向常與功力輸入之轉向相逆
解木機可與機帶串聯而用
若一物可有多種剖解之法，可用甄選槽以指定其一
若無甄選，則解木機將輪流施以諸法
create.ponder.millstone.text_1: 石碾之用，在於碾磨諸物。
create.ponder.millstone.text_2: 可以齒輪自其側面，為之供給旋力
create.ponder.millstone.text_3: 可自其頂擲入或置入諸物
create.ponder.millstone.text_4: 須臾之間，右擊取其所成之物
create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_1: 若通以紅石之能，則示其強弱之級
create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_2: 以抄簿使於熠管，則熠管示其所記
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_1: 右擊鏈機，置鼁驛於其側
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_10: 貨自循其道，達於契鼁於鏈網之上
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_14: 此亦可用於封包機，物可封而直達
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_18: 以錄事板右擊蛙埠，可錄其址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_19: 已錄地址之錄事板，可助補全他處圖儀中之地址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_2: 可於行囊圖儀中，為其指定地址
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_6: ...則蛙埠將置包裹於機帶之上
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_7: 包裹若無的放矢，則將原地自旋
create.ponder.package_frogport.text_8: 鏈條脈絡之上，處處皆可增設蛙埠
create.ponder.packager.text_1: 連接封包機至其所指之藏器
create.ponder.packager.text_2: 若得赤石之力，則將藏器之物，封為包裹
create.ponder.packager.text_3: 此等包裹，可如常物一般拾取轉運
create.ponder.packager.text_4: 凡所入之包裹，皆將自毀，解其內物於藏器之中
create.ponder.packager.text_6: 若包裹之物不能盡納，則封包機不收
create.ponder.packager_address.text_10: 為求緊湊，解木機可將封包之物，直接剖解於機帶之上
create.ponder.packager_address.text_11: 篩檢之外，蛙埠與郵櫃並具分遞之能
create.ponder.packager_address.text_4: 凡所封之包裹，將以牌上之文為址
create.ponder.packager_address.text_5: 包裹甄選器，依其址以導引包裹
create.ponder.piston_pole.text_1: 若無長桿相附，則機關鞴鞴不能動也
create.ponder.piston_pole.text_2: 其背後所增長桿之尺寸，定其伸展之界
create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: 行進機關上之儲液罐，任何管道皆不可通
此機件可與儲液罐相通，而無需機關止步
置第二枚於一二步之隙
每當二者交錯而過，則將接續
接續之時，機關上所有之儲液罐，為其埠之靜者所代
若暫無交匯，則機關行進不輟
create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: 行進之藏器，以自動之法存取，頗為不易
此機件可與藏器相通，而無需機關止步
置第二枚於一二步之隙
每當二者交錯而過，則將接續
接續之時，機關上所有之藏器，為其埠之靜者所代
若暫無交匯，則機關行進不輟
赤石加力，將阻二埠接續
create.ponder.postbox.text_1: 右擊車驛，而後置郵驛匣於其旁
create.ponder.postbox.text_11: 郵驛匣之性，有如火輪車，雖在世外，其行不輟
create.ponder.postbox.text_2: 於行囊圖儀中，為其指定地址
create.ponder.postbox.text_6: 凡停靠之車，皆收之為貨
create.ponder.postbox.text_7: 反之，凡地址相合之包裹，皆將於此卸下
create.ponder.postbox.text_8: 隨車而至之貨，可自郵驛匣取出
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_1: 機關掣者，乃為赤石所節制之拉桿也
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_2: 凡信脈自其背而入，則機關啟
create.ponder.powered_latch.text_3: 凡信脈自其側而入，則機關閉
create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.heade: 以機關掣節制信脈之法
create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.text_: 機關掣者，赤石所節制之拉桿也
凡其背後之信號，皆可變易其啟閉之態
create.ponder.pulse_extender.header: 以續脈儀節制信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_4: 以度盤可設定其發脈之時長
create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_5: 所設之時長，至長可達半個時辰
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.header: 以承脈儀節制信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_1: 承脈儀遲滯片刻，而後發一短脈
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_2: 以度盤可設定其遲滯之時長
create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_3: 所設之遲滯，至長亦可達半個時辰
create.ponder.pulse_timer.header: 候脈儀輸赤石信脈之法
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_1: 候脈儀依時而動，往復發其短脈
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_2: 以度盤可設定其發脈之間隔
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_3: 若其入口得力，則將止歇復位
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_4: 右擊其基座，可反轉其信號
create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_5: 此法可用於觸發無赤石信脈方動之機關
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_1: 徑向機骨者，可與同類者列隊相連
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_2: 機關動其一，則眾皆隨行
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_3: 徑向機骨之竅，可塗黏漿
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_5: 潛行並以空手右擊，則黏漿可去
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_7: …則將黏附其同層規內，所有可及之方塊
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_8: 以扳手可為此機骨精定其規
create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_9: 凡黏面所不及之方塊，皆不附焉
create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_1: 赤石觸點相對，則發赤石信脈
create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_2: 縱其一隨機關而行，其法亦然
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_2: 潛行右擊，以啟閉接收之式
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_4: 接收者，可發二百五十六步內，發送者之赤石之力
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_5: 置物於二槽，可定其信道
create.ponder.redstone_link.text_6: 唯信道相合者，方能互通
create.ponder.redstone_requester.header: 以赤石請領器自行約貨
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_1: 置放之前，右擊一倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_2: 有如百貨榜，赤石請領器亦可自轉運脈絡請領貨物
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_3: 右擊請領器，以啟其設定圖儀
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_4: 凡赤石脈衝一至，即依圖儀所設之序而行請領
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_5: 抑或，請領器可於置放前，預設周全
create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_6: 以此物右擊守藏吏，即可就地設定約貨
create.ponder.repackager.text_1: 有時，轉運之請領，務使其合為一包而至，此乃要事
create.ponder.repackager.text_4: 否則，或有他包雜於其間
create.ponder.repackager.text_5: 若遇此事，當改包裹之向，使其入一藏器
create.ponder.repackager.text_6: 接續重整封包機，並以赤石驅之
create.ponder.repackager.text_7: 一旦散件到齊，則將合為一新包裹而出
create.ponder.repackager.text_8: 如此，凡請領之物，皆一併而至，其序井然
create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_1: 轆轤若得功力，可垂直移動方塊
create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_2: 其行進之速與向，悉決於旋力之輸入
create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.tex: 凡轆轤為機關所攜而行…
…則其所附之結構，亦將隨之拖曳
須知，轆轤唯靜止之時，方可移動
create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_1: 凡轆轤止歇，其所動之結構，將復歸為方塊
create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_2: 可設使其永不復歸，或僅於始發之位復歸
create.ponder.rope_pulley_multi_rope.tex: …則同層之他轆轤亦將與此結構相連
此等無需功力，其效僅為觀瞻而已
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_1: 芙蓉石燈感赤石信號而亮
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_2: 其後將持續發散赤石之力
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_4: …則啟用一燈，信號將集於其上，而他燈皆滅
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_5: 較赭儀之信號，依其與已亮之燈的距離而定
create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_6: 諸燈亦可以機匙手動啟閉
易速器可將轉動自其軸心，傳至上方之巨齒輪
以其側之度盤，即可設定所傳之速
create.ponder.sail.text_2: 其與方物、及同類相接，亦不必用膠、不必憑機骨
create.ponder.sail.text_4: 以剪右擊，使其復歸為框
create.ponder.sail_frame.text_1: 帆框者，合風車之便器也
create.ponder.sail_frame.text_2: 其與方物、及同類相接，亦不必用膠、不必憑機骨
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: 循序機匣者，依計時之律令傳遞轉動也
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_3: 凡感赤石之脈，則依所編之序而行
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_4: 其序既盡，則靜候再感，以復其始
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_5: 以較赭儀可察其序行幾何
create.ponder.shaft.text_1: 機軸可沿直線傳遞轉動
create.ponder.shaft_casing.text_1: 機軸可以黃銅機殼及安山機殼飾之
create.ponder.shared.movement_anchors: 若欲運載巨物，則可用天工膠以輔之
create.ponder.shared.storage_on_contrapt: 附於機關之藏器，將自行拾取掉落之物
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_1: 巧井者，增設機巧之物井也
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_2: 甄選槽中之物，用於指定所取、所運之物
create.ponder.smart_chute.text_4: 赤石加力，則巧井不行其事
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_1: 巧察可用以探測諸般事象
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_2: 可探測尋常容器中之物與流體
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_3: 可用甄選槽，僅尋特定之物
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_4: 若其方塊本身合於甄選，亦將啟用
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_5: 此外，巧察可監看機帶、物井與管道
create.ponder.smart_observer.text_6: ……凡有物出入漏斗，則發信脈一瞬
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: 巧管可依流體之類，以節其流
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: 若徑直置於源頭，指定所汲取流體之類
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: 以盛有所欲流體之物，右擊其甄選槽
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: 若置於管道脈絡之下游，則唯相合之流體，方可續行
create.ponder.speedometer.header: 以示速儀監察旋力之情狀
create.ponder.speedometer.text_1: 示速儀所示者，乃所連機件當前之速率也
create.ponder.speedometer.text_2: 若佩工匠護目，則得以盡觀其詳
create.ponder.speedometer.text_3: 較赭儀可依示速儀之所示，發相應之赤石信脈
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_1: 注機者，可盈所呈之盛流體之器
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_2: 注機內物，不可手動存取
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_4: 待入之物，可置於注機下方之貨墩上
create.ponder.spout_filling.text_6: 凡所入之器，注機皆將自行持之以盈滿
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_1: 凡機關軸承亦隨行進之結構而動…
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_3: 復次，軸承將附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.stabilized_bearings.text_4: 是故，其所附之子機關，將通體維持其正
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: 水火機樞可置於儲液罐之上
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_2: 以機軸擊機關核心，即可造成功力輸出之口
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_5: 其最小之設，需儲液罐四
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_6: 若得焱靈爐之助，則功力可增
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_7: 欲達高階，則需水、尺寸與熱力
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_8: 可以匠人鏡，察鍋爐當前之階級
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_9: 每增一階，即可增一機樞，使其盡展其能
create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_5: 音域凡三，扳手可輪替之
create.ponder.steam_whistle.text_6: 佩工匠護目以察汽笛之音高
create.ponder.sticker.text_1: 膠漆鎖者，為赤石所節制之附物利器也
create.ponder.sticker.text_2: 凡信脈單傳，則將變易其態
create.ponder.sticker.text_3: 若隨機關而動，則其所附之方塊亦將隨行
create.ponder.sticker.text_4: 復變其態，則方塊不再相附
create.ponder.stock_link.text_1: 倉儲鏈一經置放，即倉儲脈絡生焉
create.ponder.stock_link.text_2: 右擊一舊有之鏈，即可使二者相繫
create.ponder.stock_link.text_3: 倉儲鏈連通之封包機，可使其藏器通於脈絡
create.ponder.stock_link.text_4: 脈絡上之他機件，此刻可尋得並請領其物
create.ponder.stock_link.text_5: 一經請領，藏器中之物，方為封入
create.ponder.stock_link.text_6: 倉儲鏈之信號，其界無垠，然包裹尚需轉運
create.ponder.stock_link.text_7: 赤石全力，將止鏈之傳信
create.ponder.stock_link.text_8: 強弱不等之力，將降鏈之位次，使他者先行
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_1: 置放之前，右擊一倉儲鏈以連接其脈絡
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_10: 營造銃所需之方塊，百貨榜亦可請領
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_11: 所生成之已印錄事板，交付守藏吏
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_2: 倉儲鏈連通之封包機，可使其所連之藏器通於脈絡
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_3: 百貨榜可自此等藏器中請領貨物
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_4: 凡坐於其前之生靈或焱靈爐，皆可為守藏吏
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_5: 右擊守藏吏，以請領貨物
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_6: 約貨既交，諸物將入包裹
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_7: 自此，可將其轉運至請領之處
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_8: 以物性或名錄甄選，可為物帳增設門類
create.ponder.stock_ticker.text_9: 右擊百貨榜，以啟門類編纂之圖儀
create.ponder.stock_ticker_address.heade: 百貨榜之約貨定址之法
create.ponder.stock_ticker_address.text_: 請領貨物，可於請領條陳，設定其址
篩檢之外，蛙埠與郵櫃並具分遞之能
所設之址，維附於為此請領所造之包裹
以包裹甄選器，可節制此等包裹所去
create.ponder.stressometer.header: 以功力計監察功力之情狀
create.ponder.stressometer.text_1: 功力計所示者，乃所連脈絡之功力承載也
create.ponder.stressometer.text_2: 遊者若佩匠人鏡，可自計上得更詳之情狀
create.ponder.stressometer.text_3: 較赭儀可依功力計之所示，發相應之赤石信號
create.ponder.super_glue.text_1: 天工膠能合諸方物為一體，以成機關
create.ponder.super_glue.text_2: 點其兩端，則成一膠合之域
create.ponder.super_glue.text_3: 若欲去膠，則手持其膠以拳擊之
create.ponder.super_glue.text_4: 凡方物鄰接而共一域者，皆可互為牽引
create.ponder.super_glue.text_5: 膠合之域，凡有重疊，必聯動也
create.ponder.super_glue.text_6: 懸於他物者，常無需用膠
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_10: 收付之時，所購之物，悉數囊於一包。
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_11: 所納之包，可自此運至店前。
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_12: 凡酬勞，皆將存於百貨榜
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_2: 若得轉運系統之助，亦可用以售賣貨物
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_3: 始於商鋪之藏器、一封包機及一倉儲鏈
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_4: 繫百貨榜於倉儲鏈，而後置之於商鋪
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_5: 可僱一生靈或焱靈爐為掌櫃
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_6: 以待售之物，填滿商鋪之藏器
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_7: 欲開新交易，則手持貨攤布，與掌櫃互動
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_8: 置定之後，於側面之物格中，為之定價
create.ponder.table_cloth.text_9: 他遊者可與此商鋪交易
create.ponder.tag.arm_targets.descriptio: 凡可為機關臂選定為出入之口者
create.ponder.tag.contraption_actor.desc: 凡附於行進機關之上，而顯現特殊習性之機件
create.ponder.tag.contraption_assembly.d: 用以合裝行進機關之諸般工具與機件
create.ponder.tag.creative.description: 凡俗之世中，尋常不可得之機件
create.ponder.tag.display_sources.descri: 可供諸機件或方塊，示聯可讀也
create.ponder.tag.display_targets.descri: 凡可措置並揭示示聯所傳數據之機件或方塊
create.ponder.tag.fluids.description: 凡傳輸、運用流體之機件
create.ponder.tag.high_logistics.descrip: 凡調度諸方倉儲、自行請領之機件
create.ponder.tag.movement_anchor.descri: 此類機件，可用以建造行進之機關，使其所附之結構，依諸般法式而動。
create.ponder.tag.redstone.description: 凡營造赤石機關之機件
create.ponder.tag.threshold_switch_targe: 閾關可自此等方塊，及多數盛物、盛流體之藏器，讀取其數。
create.ponder.tag.train_related.descript: 凡建造、調度火輪車機關所用之機件也
create.ponder.tag.windmill_sails.descrip: 凡合裝之時，可增益風車機關之力者。其類諸物，其效皆同。
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_1: 閾關可監察藏器之盈滿之度
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_4: 信脈方續，直至其物觸及下閾方止
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_5: 赤石信號，此後可用以節制供物，以保…
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_6: 其上下之閾，可於圖儀中變易
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_7: 可用甄選，使其僅計特定之物
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_8: 流體之儲量，亦可以此法監察之
create.ponder.threshold_switch.text_9: …奇哉，亦及其繩索垂下之長短
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_1: 軌道雖在已載之域外，其用不輟
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_2: 火輪車穿行世外之域，通行無礙
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_3: 然遇車驛或示止之號令，其以停焉
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_4: 然，機鑽及車上他機關，則不行其事
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_5: 一旦近遊者，則車體復現
create.ponder.track_observer.text_1: 擇定車軌，而後置行車察於其旁
create.ponder.track_observer.text_2: 凡火輪車之經行標記者，行車察皆能知之
create.ponder.track_observer.text_3: 探械可設甄選，唯遇相合之貨，方纔觸發
create.ponder.track_placement.text_1: 此軌乃新制，專為火輪車機關所造
create.ponder.track_placement.text_2: 欲大批量鋪設軌道，可先擊一既有之軌
create.ponder.track_placement.text_3: 而後置或擇第二段軌道
create.ponder.track_placement.text_5: 接續之時，軌道力求諸彎弧長相等
create.ponder.track_placement.text_6: 接續之時，若長按疾行之鍵…
create.ponder.track_placement.text_8: 副手所持之物料，將自行鋪於軌下
create.ponder.track_portal.text_1: 軌道若緊鄰焱界界門而設…
create.ponder.track_portal.text_2: …則將試於門之另側，造一配對之軌道
create.ponder.track_portal.text_3: 火輪車行於此軌之上，則可跨界而行
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_1: 擇定車軌，而後置車驛於其旁
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_10: 凡火輪車，其上必備行車主控一具
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_11: 若增設其二，則可雙向發車
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_12: 啟車驛圖儀，以定合車之議
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_13: 火輪車之解體，唯車驛可行之，以復歸方物
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_14: 若以輿圖用於車驛，則圖上將增其處標記，並註其名
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_15: 已成之車，可以扳手遷之於近軌之上
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_2: 車驛者，軌道脈絡之要衝也
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_3: 欲造新車，啟其圖儀，轉入合車之式
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_4: 合車之時，凡有行期之車，皆不過此驛
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_5: 置軌輿機匣于軌道上，可以建轉向架
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_6: 復擊車軌，以更易輪組之式
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_8: 已成之車，若於車上箱篋中覓得燃物，其行益速
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_9: 藏於秘庫之燃物，則車不耗用之
create.ponder.train_controls.text_1: 凡火輪車機關，必備行車主控
create.ponder.train_controls.text_2: 合車既畢，右擊主控，即可駕之
create.ponder.train_controls.text_3: 加減其速，左右其向，皆憑行進之鍵
create.ponder.train_controls.text_4: 若欲，可以上下滾輪微調至速之限
create.ponder.train_controls.text_6: 火輪車之解體，唯車驛可行之，以復歸方物
create.ponder.train_controls.text_7: 已裝之氣哨，可以疾行鍵鳴之
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_1: 行程書之用，可使他人代駕火輪車
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_2: 手持此物而右擊，以啟其圖儀
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_3: 編定之後，即可將行程書付與駕車士
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_4: 凡百生靈或炎靈，坐於主控前者，皆可為駕車士
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_5: 繫繩之物，入座尤為便利
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_6: 行程書可隨時自駕車士之手取回
create.ponder.train_signal_placement.tex: 擇定車軌，而後置行車號令於其旁
號令者，所以節制非遊者所駕之車也
凡依行期之車，絕不逆向越過號令
若增設反向之號令，則另當別論
可加裝輝光管，以彰其號燈
create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.head: 號令與赤石
create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.text: 赤石之力可強令號令示止
反之，號令示止，則較赭儀亦有所應
create.ponder.train_signal_signaling.tex: 行車號令者，分軌為段也
一段之內，若有車佔，則他車不得復入
是故，每段之內，一時僅容一車
以扳手擊之，可得號令之二式
黃銅號令之後，常繼之以尋常號令
此特製號令停車，復增一則
凡入此段而不能即去者……
此法可使等候之車，暫不入繁忙之段
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_1: 閥柄可用以依精確之圭角，旋轉機件
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_2: 其圭角可於輸入度盤上設定
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_4: 潛行右擊，則逆向旋轉之
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_5: 須知，必先諭令軸承，勿使其解體
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_6: 為觀瞻計，閥柄可染雜色
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_1: 閥管者，節制流體之傳播也
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_2: 其機軸之輸入，節制流體之通過
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_3: 凡得以開啟之向施加旋力，則閥將開
create.ponder.valve_pipe.text_4: 若逆轉輸入之旋力，則可復閉之
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_1: 水車者，憑流而轉，力之源也
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_2: 使流覆他方，弗能曾其力
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_3: 執木材而擊之，得更其貌
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_1: 潛行並手持飛貨墩右擊，以選定其的所在
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_10: 此後，其所彈之物，將限於此疊數。唯其上之物積至此數，方能觸發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: 凡生靈、遊者，踏足其上，必觸發飛貨墩
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_2: 已置之飛貨墩，將發物至已標之位
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_3: 其的若在界內，則高低遠近不拘
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_5: 若未選定其的，則將以正前方之方塊為的
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_7: 置物於飛貨墩之上，即可觸發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_8: 若以藏器為的，則飛貨墩必待其有容乃發
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_9: 以度盤可設定所需之疊數
以赤石節制配重飛貨墩
凡赤石加力之時，飛貨墩則不行其事
探械能察知飛貨墩啟用之時
create.ponder.weighted_ejector_tunnel.te: 飛貨墩若與黃銅甬道合用，可按定數分割疊物
其一，先設黃銅甬道為「擇近」之式，以使其側之出口為先
飛貨墩上所設之疊數，即為分割而出之數
其側出口，將出一疊合於定數之新物…
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_1: 風車轂可附於其前方之方塊
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_3: 若其間有足夠之帆狀方塊，則可為風車
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_4: 右擊以啟用之，則風車轂始供旋力
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_5: 帆之多寡，定其旋轉之速率
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_6: 以度盤可設定其旋力之轉向
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_7: 可隨時右擊轂，以止其動，復編其結構
create.ponder.windmill_structure.text_1: 凡結構，苟含帆狀方塊八枚以上者，皆可為有效之風車
create.portal_track.missing: 其的所在之界門，尚未生成
create.redstone_requester.keeper_too_far: 請領器與守藏吏相去過遠
create.schedule.applied_to_train: 火輪車現依此行期而動
create.schedule.instruction.filter_edit_: 擇近處無車佔之合驛而往
create.schedule.instruction.name_edit_bo: 變易揭示榜上所示之文
其本用，乃下一驛站之名
create.schedule.non_controlling_seat: 駕車士須席於主控之前
create.schedule.remove_with_empty_hand: 以空手移除當前行程書
create.schematic.error: 籍圖不堪加載 - 請检閱戏志
create.schematic.invalid: [!] 無效之物 - 于籍圖案替之
create.schematic.tool.deploy.description: 押 [Ctrl]，並滾滑鼠，然後距離生變。
create.schematic.tool.flip.description.1: 擇定籍圖，再押 [Ctrl]，並滾滑鼠，然後籍圖得轉。
create.schematic.tool.move.description.1: 擇定籍圖，再押 [Ctrl]，並滾滑鼠，然後籍圖得动。
create.schematic.tool.move_y.description: 押 [Ctrl] ，並滾滑鼠，然後縱深可變。
create.schematic.tool.rotate.description: 押 [Ctrl] ，並滾滑鼠，旋度半之半周。
create.schematicAndQuill.failed: 存營造式樣不成，閱日誌以得詳情

effect.ars_elemental.enderference.descri: Makes the target unable to teleport or be teleported.
effect.ars_elemental.enthralled.descript: Enthralled mobs won't attack the caster but defend them.
effect.ars_elemental.frozen.description: The target is frozen and can't heal, next fire damage taken is increased but dispels the effect.
effect.ars_elemental.hellfire.descriptio: The magic flames burns even nether creatures making them vulnerable to fire. It slighly decrease damage taken from earth, but let magic damage pierce through some of the armor.
effect.ars_elemental.hymn_of_order.descr: Unobtainable potion, for Admin use. Sets the punished player's mana to 1 and disables spellcasting, greatly reducing their chances to create chaos in the server.
effect.ars_elemental.life_link.descripti: Caster will split incoming damage with the target and the target will split incoming healing with the caster. Using Cut will dispel the effect on both sides.
effect.ars_elemental.mana_shield.descrip: Use mana to mitigate damage taken and add a chance to not suffer from negative effects.
effect.ars_elemental.mist.description: Similar to blindness, mist reduces the field of vision of mobs and players
effect.ars_elemental.repel.description: The target is repelled from one or more places by a magic force.
effect.ars_elemental.rust.description: Makes the entity armor rust temporarily, dropping its armor points.
effect.ars_elemental.slip_feet.descripti: Makes the entity slide as if on ice while on normal blocks, increased slipperiness on ice blocks.
effect.ars_elemental.static_charged.desc: Calls a lightning to hit the afflicted when the duration ends.
effect.ars_elemental.venom.description: The target is poisoned with a deadly venom and takes more damage from poison spores.
effect.ars_elemental.watery_grave.descri: Makes the target sink and run out of air quicker.
effect.ars_nouveau.blasting.desc: Causes the target to explode when the duration ends.
effect.ars_nouveau.bounce.desc: Causes the entity to bounce off of surfaces.
effect.ars_nouveau.glide.desc: Allows the player to glide as if wearing an Elytra.
effect.ars_nouveau.gravity.desc: Causes the entity to rapidly fall.
effect.ars_nouveau.hex.desc: Increases the damage taken potion and non-player damage.
effect.ars_nouveau.looting.desc: Increases the amount of loot dropped by mobs
effect.ars_nouveau.magic_find.desc: Causes nearby magical entities to glow.
effect.ars_nouveau.recovery.desc: Increases healing received from all sources.
effect.ars_nouveau.shielding.desc: Reduces the amount of damage taken.
effect.ars_nouveau.shocked.desc: Increases the damage taken from lightning damage.
effect.ars_nouveau.soaked.desc: Wets the target, protecting from fire and triggering effects as if under the rain.
effect.ars_nouveau.spell_damage.desc: Increases the damage dealt by spells.
effect.ars_nouveau.summoning_sickness.de: Prevents summoning for a short duration.
effect.ars_zero.zero_gravity.description: Temporarily removes gravity from the entity
effect.sauce.contingency.desc: When a specific event triggers, it will cast the spell on the entity.
enchantment.ars_additions.spellweave.des: Provides a thread slot on armor that doesn't have threads.
Shield have a chance to reflect projectile spells
enchantment.ars_nouveau.mana_boost.desc: Increases the maximum mana of the player.
enchantment.ars_nouveau.mana_regen.desc: Increases the mana regeneration of the player.
enchantment.ars_nouveau.reactive.desc: Has a chance to cast the inscribed spell on tool use or player hurt.

_創造_之器，用以遙修萬里之山河。

not_enough_glyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_conti: The contingency will trigger after the target teleports.
The contingency will trigger after the target's death. It will still trigger if the target survives with a totem.
The contingency will trigger after the target is in free fall for enough time, casting the spell contained within. Base at 5 blocks and increases/decreases by 1 per Amplify/Dampen.
The contingency will trigger after the target is hurt from fire damage, casting the spell contained within.
The contingency will trigger after the target heals, casting the spell contained within.
The contingency will trigger after the target's health falls below a certain threshold, casting the spell contained within. Base at 20% and increases by 10% per Amplify.
The contingency will trigger after a certain amount of time, casting the spell contained within. Won't trigger if forcefully dispelled.
not_enough_glyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filte: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a dark area. The light threshold for this glyph is 8 and ignores sunlight.
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an area with enough sunlight. The light threshold for this glyph is 8 and ignores artificial light.
not_enough_glyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_plow: Simulate the use of an Hoe on blocks.
not_enough_glyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_propa: Resolves the remainder of the spell into a wider plane, starting from the block hit and extending based on applied AoE and Pierce. Add Sensitive to make the plane circular. Add Dampen to make the plane hollow.
not_enough_glyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_trail: Fire a projectile that resolves the spell multiple times on its trail. Add Sensitive to make it resolve on blocks. Use extend time to reduce the delay between each cast and AoE to increase the area of effect.
not_enough_glyphs.page.book_threads.desc: The book threads are at the core of the spellbinder. They allow to give your binder special properties and effects, similar to how Armor Threads work. You can use an Alteration Table to slot up to two threads into the Spell Binder.
not_enough_glyphs.page.spell_binder: An alternative to the traditional spellcasting, the spellbinder is a tool that allows to cast spells from the spell parchemnts and caster tomes put inside it. The left side will hold the 10 spells for the radial menu (V), while the right side allow to keep additional 15 spells to switch when needed.

page.ars_additions.dispel_protection_cha: This charm allows you to shrug off a Dispel, and keep all your powerful buffs active.

starbunclemania.balloon.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport Mekanism chemical around. Can be dyed and used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Drygmy, Wixie.
starbunclemania.battery.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport FE energy around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.bucket.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport fluids around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.builder_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to place blocks in specified spots. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.chef_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic curio for Players, Starbuncles and Wixie Familiars.
starbunclemania.degree_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic for your familiars. Supported creatures: Starbuncles, Bookwyrm (Familiar). Also allows item starbuncles to read Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_pickup_: Pickups Fluids from world and fill a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_place_f: Place Fluid in world, draining from a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.miner_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to mine blocks in specified spots. You can give it a tool to use, defaults to an iron pick. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.page.direction_scroll: Provides a face/direction to Starbuncle automations. When the scroll is used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on a block, the starbuncle will interact with the block from the specified face.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_jar: A tank made from cascading archwood logs that can hold up to 16 buckets of fluid. If used to store a potion fluid and a potion jar is placed above it, the fluid will be converted to the jar for flask/melding use.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_scroll: Provides a filter to Starbuncle fluid automations. Works like the item counterpart, used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on the tank.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_sourcelink: Consumes fluids to generate source. Will automatically drain from tanks below it if compatible.
starbunclemania.page.player_cosmetic: Have you ever wanted to look a bit more like a Starbuncle? Or have a cool sandy hat, horns or even a propeller? Now you can! These accessories are purely cosmetic and can be worn by players in the Head curio slot.
starbunclemania.page.robin_mask: Allows Starbuncles to round-robin items between inventories. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle will only pickup items from the ground. Each stacked starbuncle will carry maxStack/numDestInventories items, before moving to the next inventory.
starbunclemania.page.source_condenser: Condense the Source from Jars into a stable fluid. Will automatically output to tanks below it if possible.
starbunclemania.page.star_balloon: Allows Starbuncles to transport simple gasses [Mekanism]. Can be dyed if used as cosmetic, but will use the stored gas color when used for transport. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between gas tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_battery: Allows Starbuncles to transport energy. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between FE blocks.
starbunclemania.page.star_bin: Allows Starbuncles to embrace their inner raccoon and trash items. While wearing the accessory the Starbuncle will void any nearby item on the ground.
starbunclemania.page.star_bucket: Allows Starbuncles to transport fluids. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_hat: Accessories from StarbuncleMania aren't just for the worker starbuncles to enjoy, you can use them on your starbuncle familiar too! This one doesn't do anything, but is surely stylish. Shift-clicking a starby with an accessory will only set it as cosmetic, without setting the job.
starbunclemania.page.star_saddle: Allows Starbuncles to transport players. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle becomes big enough to be rideable. [Still a bit wip, might be a bit wonky]
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cook: The Wixie can now cook! Place a Wixie on a furnace to allow it to smelt and smoke items, also compatible with a cooking pot [Farmers Delight] and crucibles [EidolonRepraised] to automate them.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cut: Place a Wixie charm on a stonecutter or on a cutting board to have it use their cutting recipes for craftings.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_mixer: Place a Wixie charm on a fluid jar to convert it to a different type of cauldron. The Mixer has two internal tanks, for water and milk, to avoid using buckets in recipes. Only works for crafting table recipes, will always consume only one unit of the fluid needed.
starbunclemania.page.wyrm_degree: Allows Starbuncles to insert/extract items from a specific side with Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.robin_mask.tooltip: Tweaks the starbuncle's item transport to round-robin items between inventories, also stops pickup. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.simple_cosmetic.tooltip: Simple cosmetic for your familiars. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Wixie, Drygmy, Bookwyrm.
starbunclemania.trash_bin.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to void the items it pickups and from linked chests. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cooking_p: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cooking Pot. With this, Wixies will use cooking pot recipes
Use a Wixie Charm on a Crucible. With this, Wixies will use Eidolon's crucible recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cutting_b: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cutting Board. With this, Wixies will use cutting board recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.mixer.too: Use a Wixie Charm on a Fluid Jar. With this, Wixies will use the milk and water in the side tanks for crafting recipes instead of buckets.
Use a Wixie Charm on a Furnace. With this, Wixies will use smelt and smoke recipes.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.stonecutt: Use a Wixie Charm on a Stonecutter. With this, Wixies  will use stonecutter recipes

telemetry.event.game_load_times.title: Game Load Times
telemetry.event.performance_metrics.desc:
Knowing the overall performance profile of Minecraft helps us tune and optimize the game for a wide range of machine specifications and operating systems. 
Game version is included to help us compare the performance profile for new versions of Minecraft.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It’s important for us to understand how long it takes to join a world, and how that changes over time. For example, when we add new features or do larger technical changes, we need to see what impact that had on load times.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.title: World Load Times
telemetry.event.world_loaded.description:
Knowing how players play Minecraft (such as Game Mode, client or server modded, and game version) allows us to focus game updates to improve the areas that players care about most.
The World Loaded event is paired with the World Unloaded event to calculate how long the play session has lasted.
telemetry.event.world_loaded.title: World Loaded
telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
This event is paired with the World Loaded event to calculate how long the world session has lasted.
The duration (in seconds and ticks) is measured when a world session has ended (quitting to title, disconnecting from a server).

toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_chaining: Causes a spell to chain through multiple grouped targets, either similar blocks or living entities other than the caster. AOE increases target count. Pierce increases maximum jump distance between targets.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_an: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Animal
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_bl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Block
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_en: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_is: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a baby
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an adult
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_it: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_li: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Monster
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Player
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_mo: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_pl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_ray: Instantaneously strikes the pointed-at target, at limited yet greater range than Touch. Mana is expended whether or not the ray hits anything. AOE increases range. Sensitive 1 lets the ray strike objects that do not block motion, such as plants or floating Magelight globes. Sensitive 2 allows the ray to strike fluids.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_reverse_d: Reverses the direction of the spell, making it resolve as it was cast from the opposite side of the block. Especially useful with block-placing spells, as reversing the direction of pierce will point towards the caster instead of away.
